answer: Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The ledge explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Splitting into 9 separate vaults requires a separate funded tundra account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
